name: Rootly MCP
description: Connects AI assistants and IDEs to Rootly incident management: query and update incidents, alerts and on-call schedules, and find similar past incidents. For SRE and on-call teams.

skills.name: Incident & Alert Response
skills.description: Finds and updates incidents and alerts and looks up who is on call, using Rootly's core everyday incident response tools.

skills.name: Find Related Incidents
skills.description: Finds historically similar past incidents using TF-IDF similarity analysis so responders can reuse what worked before.

skills.name: Suggest Solutions
skills.description: Suggests actionable next steps for an open incident by mining the resolutions recorded on past Rootly incidents.

skills.name: On-Call Handoff Summary
skills.description: Summarizes the current and next on-call responders plus incidents during their shifts, with optional regional filtering.

skills.name: On-Call Shift Metrics
skills.description: Reports on-call shift counts, hours and days grouped by user, team or schedule to review responder workload.
